name: Cable Management Tray
description: Simple Basic cable tray for organized desk cable management. Under-desk mount design keeps cables tidy and off the floor for a clean workspace.

reviews.author: Anil Kumar
reviews.title: Clean workspace achieved!
reviews.comment: Under-desk mount keeps cables organized! Easy installation. Durable material. My desk looks much cleaner now. Good purchase!

reviews.author: Pooja Singh
reviews.title: Simple cable management
reviews.comment: Wire organization made easy. Cables off the floor. Good value for keeping workspace tidy!

name: Cup Holder
description: Simple Basic cup holder that clips to your desk edge. Keeps beverages within easy reach while saving valuable desk space.

reviews.author: Rahul Saxena
reviews.title: Simple and effective!
reviews.comment: Clips easily to my desk. Saves space and keeps my coffee safe. Good quality for the price!

reviews.author: Priya Nair
reviews.title: Handy desk accessory
reviews.comment: Works well for cups and bottles. Installation is super easy. Useful addition to my workspace!

name: Desk Shelf Tray
description: A two-tier shelf that clamps to the back edge of the desk and lifts the monitor, speakers and whatever else has crept onto the surface up off it. The space underneath comes back for a keyboard, a notebook or a lamp. Slots along each shelf let cables drop straight through to the tray below, and because it clamps rather than screws, a height-adjustable desk still moves normally.

name: Desk Side Organiser
description: Hooks over the side of the desk and takes the things that otherwise colonise the work surface: notebooks and files in the wide slot, pens and scissors in the cup, headphones on the hook underneath. It hangs off the edge rather than standing on the desk, so it costs no surface area and needs nothing drilled.

name: Footrest
description: Ergonomic Basic footrest to improve posture and reduce leg fatigue. Simple, sturdy design with non-slip surface for comfortable foot support during work.

reviews.author: Sanjay Desai
reviews.title: Good ergonomic addition
reviews.comment: Non-slip surface works well. Improves my posture during long work hours. Compact size fits under desk perfectly. Good value!

reviews.author: Lakshmi Iyer
reviews.title: Reduces leg fatigue
reviews.comment: Ergonomic angle is comfortable. Durable construction. Simple but effective. Recommended for desk workers!

name: Keyboard Tray
description: Clamps under the desk and carries the keyboard and mouse below the surface, which lets a desk that is the right height for a monitor also be the right height for your elbows. The front edge is padded across its full width as a wrist rest, and the tray is wide enough to keep the mouse alongside the keyboard rather than up on the desk.

name: Peg-Board
description: A perforated steel board that clamps to the back edge of the desk and stands upright behind it, turning the wall of space above the desk into storage. Hooks, pen cups and holders locate anywhere on the grid and move when the setup changes. Nothing is fixed to the wall, so it comes with you and leaves no holes.

name: Neuro Mesh Chair
description: High-performance Atlas mesh chair with superior ergonomic design and premium build quality. Features enhanced breathability and maximum comfort for demanding work environments.

reviews.author: Deepak Srivastava
reviews.title: Neuro chair is a powerhouse!
reviews.comment: The Neuro mesh chair handles long hours effortlessly. The high-load capacity frame gives me great confidence and the anti-fatigue lumbar curve is a real back-saver!

reviews.author: Pooja Bhattacharya
reviews.title: Best ergonomic chair under 15k!
reviews.comment: I've tried many chairs at this price range but Neuro stands out. The synchro-tilt mechanism is incredibly smooth and the mesh keeps me cool all day.

reviews.author: Suraj Pillai
reviews.title: Solid build, great for tall users
reviews.comment: As someone 6 feet tall, the adjustable headrest and 3D armrests finally fit me perfectly. Very comfortable after minor adjustments. Highly satisfied!

name: Xyron Mesh Chair
description: Next-generation Xyron mesh chair engineered for maximum comfort and style. Features ultra-breathable dual-layer mesh, full 4D armrest control, and an innovative self-adjusting lumbar system for unmatched all-day support.

reviews.author: Aakash Menon
reviews.title: Zynx is on another level!
reviews.comment: The dual-layer mesh is unlike anything I've sat on before — incredibly breathable and supportive at the same time. The self-adjusting lumbar just finds the right spot. Best chair I've ever owned!

reviews.author: Neha Kulkarni
reviews.title: Worth every rupee and more!
reviews.comment: As someone with chronic lower back issues, the Zynx has been a revelation. The lumbar system adapts as I shift position. 10-hour work days are now completely comfortable. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Saurabh Tiwari
reviews.title: Premium build, premium comfort
reviews.comment: The aluminium base feels rock solid and the 4D armrests are incredibly precise. The mesh quality is clearly a step above other chairs in this range. A true flagship mesh chair!

reviews.author: Divya Iyer
reviews.title: Excellent chair, takes time to set up
reviews.comment: Assembly took about an hour but the result is worth it. The recline lock is smooth and the neck cushion on the headrest is a thoughtful touch. Very comfortable for long hours!

name: Zynx Mesh Chair
description: Premium mesh chair with advanced lumbar support and adjustable headrest. Designed for professionals who value comfort and productivity.

reviews.author: Manpreet Gill
reviews.title: Hujing - the ultimate mesh chair!
reviews.comment: This is my third mesh chair and by far the best. The Hujing's lumbar support is exceptionally well-positioned and the premium mesh fabric feels luxurious. No more back aches!

reviews.author: Sunanda Krishnaswamy
reviews.title: Worth every single rupee at this price!
reviews.comment: As a data analyst working 14-hour shifts, the Hujing chair has been a game changer. The gas lift adjustment is silky smooth and the synchro-tilt is perfect for thinking breaks.

reviews.author: Farhan Qureshi
reviews.title: Premium feel, slight assembly learning curve
reviews.comment: The chair quality is top-tier. 3D armrests are unique and very useful. Assembly took about 45 minutes but the result is incredible. Highly recommend for serious users.

name: Casca Performance Mesh Chair
description: Premium Casca fabric chair with luxurious upholstery and superior comfort. Designed with high-quality fabric and ergonomic support for all-day comfort.

reviews.author: Ishaan Khanna
reviews.title: Premium fabric chair - worth it!
reviews.comment: The luxury fabric upholstery is outstanding! Enhanced lumbar support really helps during long work sessions. Best fabric chair I've used!

reviews.author: Kavya Reddy
reviews.title: Superior comfort all day
reviews.comment: Amazing chair! The adjustable components let me find the perfect position. Durable construction and beautiful design. Love it!

reviews.author: Rohan Joshi
reviews.title: Great quality fabric chair
reviews.comment: Very comfortable and well-made. The fabric feels premium. Assembly was easy. Slightly expensive but quality justifies the price.

name: Luxor Performance Mesh Chair
description: A high-back task chair with a performance-mesh back stretched inside a moulded frame, so the support comes from the frame's shape rather than from padding that flattens. Fixed loop arms, a gas lift and a tilt mechanism under the seat, on a five-star nylon base with castors. The taller back is the point: it carries the shoulders, not just the lumbar.

name: Pointer Performance Mesh Chair
description: A performance-mesh task chair with an adjustable headrest and height-adjustable arms, built around a moulded frame that shapes the back rather than relying on foam. Gas lift and tilt under the seat, five-star nylon base on castors. The headrest is the difference between this and the Luxor, and it matters most on calls and in any chair you lean back in.

name: Flex Apex Bed Table
description: A folding table sized for working from a bed or a sofa. The legs fold flat against the underside, so it stores upright in a gap rather than needing floor space, and the marble-effect top is wide enough for a laptop with a notebook or a mug beside it. Light enough to carry in one hand between rooms.

name: Imperium Executive Table
description: Luxury Imperium executive desk with expansive surface and premium craftsmanship. Features built-in filing system, integrated lighting, and executive-grade finish.

reviews.author: Rahul Khanna
reviews.title: Luxury desk worth every penny!
reviews.comment: Built-in filing system is incredibly convenient! Integrated lighting is perfect for evening work. Expansive surface handles everything. Premium craftsmanship!

reviews.author: Anjali Menon
reviews.title: Ultimate executive desk!
reviews.comment: Luxury finish transforms my office! All features work perfectly. Executive-grade quality throughout. Best investment for my home office!

name: Signature Executive Table
description: Luxury Signature executive desk with expansive surface and premium craftsmanship. Features built-in filing system, integrated lighting, and executive-grade finish.

reviews.author: Rahul Khanna
reviews.title: Luxury desk worth every penny!
reviews.comment: Built-in filing system is incredibly convenient! Integrated lighting is perfect for evening work. Expansive surface handles everything. Premium craftsmanship!

reviews.author: Anjali Menon
reviews.title: Ultimate executive desk!
reviews.comment: Luxury finish transforms my office! All features work perfectly. Executive-grade quality throughout. Best investment for my home office!

name: Exquisite Folding Table
description: Mid-size Exquisite folding table with reinforced frame and larger surface area. Perfect for dining, work, or events with quick setup and takedown.

reviews.author: Deepa Kulkarni
reviews.title: Perfect for family gatherings!
reviews.comment: Larger surface area is great for 6 people. Reinforced frame is very stable. Quick setup makes it ideal for parties. Excellent purchase!

reviews.author: Sandeep Yadav
reviews.title: Good mid-size folding table
reviews.comment: Durable finish and sturdy build. Use it for work and dining. Easy to store when not in use. Good value!

name: Nextable Folding Table
description: The Exquisite Pro is the ultimate folding table for professionals and families alike. Features a waterproof anti-scratch tabletop, one-click fold mechanism, and carry handle — the easiest fold-and-go table in the range.

reviews.author: Sunil Mathur
reviews.title: One-click fold is a revelation!
reviews.comment: Set up and packed away in seconds. The carry handle makes it easy to move between rooms. Waterproof surface survived a spilled glass of juice with zero damage. Brilliant product!

reviews.author: Ananya Bhat
reviews.title: Perfect for big family gatherings
reviews.comment: Easily seats 8 people and the reinforced legs don't flex at all. The anti-scratch surface still looks brand new after several uses. Best folding table we've ever bought!

reviews.author: Rohan Saxena
reviews.title: Sturdy, portable and practical
reviews.comment: The non-slip rubber feet keep the table perfectly stable on tiled floors. One-click mechanism is smooth. Great value upgrade over the standard models!

name: Phantom Gaming Desk
description: A Z-frame gaming desk with a carbon-textured top, an LED strip running the front edge, and a headphone hook and cup holder mounted at the side so neither takes up desk space. The surface is deep enough for an ultrawide monitor with a full keyboard and mouse in front of it, and the tower sits on the floor inside the frame rather than in the legroom.

name: Quantum Gaming Desk
description: The Quantum Gaming Desk is engineered for serious gamers who demand performance and style. Features a spacious carbon-fibre texture surface, built-in RGB LED strip, cable management cutouts, and a headphone hook — everything a modern gaming battlestation needs.

reviews.author: Arjun Kapoor
reviews.title: Best gaming desk I've ever used!
reviews.comment: The RGB strip looks incredible at night and the carbon-fibre texture feels premium. Cable management cutouts are perfectly placed for my dual-monitor setup. This desk is a game changer — literally!

reviews.author: Sneha Pillai
reviews.title: Huge surface, perfect for everything
reviews.comment: Fits two 27-inch monitors, keyboard, mouse pad, and still has room to spare. The headphone hook and cup holder are super convenient. Heavy-duty frame feels rock solid!

reviews.author: Vivek Anand
reviews.title: Great desk, assembly takes time
reviews.comment: The quality is excellent and the RGB adds great ambiance. Assembly took about 90 minutes but the result is worth every minute. My gaming room looks completely transformed!

name: Modexa Height Adjustable Table
description: A sit-stand desk raised and lowered by a hand crank under the right-hand side rather than a motor, which means no cable to the wall and nothing electrical to fail. The crank folds away against the frame when it is not being turned. A wood-finish top on a black steel frame, sized as a primary desk rather than a side table.

name: Modulus Height Adjustable Table
description: The flagship Modulus Primex is the pinnacle of sit-stand desk engineering. Features an AI-powered posture reminder, 6 memory presets, ultra-wide surface for multi-monitor setups, and a built-in wireless charging pad — redefining what a height adjustable desk can be.

reviews.author: Aditya Krishnan
reviews.title: The smartest desk I've ever used!
reviews.comment: The AI posture reminder actually helped me fix my slouching habit within a week! 6 memory presets mean every family member has their own height saved. The XL surface handles 3 monitors effortlessly. This is the future of desks!

reviews.author: Preethi Nambiar
reviews.title: Wireless charging + standing desk = perfect
reviews.comment: I always forget to charge my phone. The built-in wireless pad means it charges just by sitting on the desk. The dual motor is rock solid and whisper-quiet. Absolutely premium product!

reviews.author: Gaurav Kapoor
reviews.title: Best home office investment ever
reviews.comment: The cable spine management finally solved my cable chaos. XL surface is huge — there's room for everything. Dual motor provides incredible stability even at full height. Zero regrets!

reviews.author: Meena Patel
reviews.title: Premium in every way
reviews.comment: The AI reminder feature takes a day or two to calibrate but once set it works brilliantly. The desk itself is stunning — solid, smooth and incredibly functional. Worth every rupee!

name: Modura Height Adjustable Table
description: Advanced Modura sit-stand desk with dual motor system for enhanced stability. Features programmable height memory and whisper-quiet operation.

reviews.author: Arjun Bhatia
reviews.title: Dual motor is amazing!
reviews.comment: The dual motor system provides incredible stability! 4 memory presets are perfect for my family. Whisper-quiet operation. Premium quality!

reviews.author: Pooja Narayan
reviews.title: Professional grade desk!
reviews.comment: Anti-collision feature gives peace of mind. Smooth and quiet operation. Enhanced stability is noticeable. Best standing desk purchase!

name: Movix Height Adjustable Table
description: Premium Modvix standing desk with maximum stability and load capacity. Professional-grade with triple motor system and smart control features.

reviews.author: Vikram Mehta
reviews.title: Triple motor is incredible!
reviews.comment: The stability and load capacity are unmatched! Smart controls make it so easy to use. Premium materials throughout. Worth the premium price!

reviews.author: Divya Sharma
reviews.title: Ultimate standing desk!
reviews.comment: Professional-grade quality is evident. Can handle multiple monitors with ease. Smart features are intuitive. Best desk I've ever owned!

name: Zenith Study Table
description: Enhanced Zenith study desk with multi-level storage and ergonomic design. Features keyboard tray, CPU stand, and adjustable shelving for comprehensive study setup.

reviews.author: Akash Verma (College Student)
reviews.title: Complete study setup!
reviews.comment: Multi-level storage is amazing! Keyboard tray perfect for my laptop. CPU stand holds my desktop securely. Best study desk for tech students!

reviews.author: Mrs. Gupta
reviews.title: Excellent for online learning!
reviews.comment: Son loves the ergonomic design! Adjustable shelves grow with his needs. Comprehensive setup in one desk. Highly recommend!

name: Zenvy Study Table
description: Premium Zenvy Primex study workstation with complete organization system. Includes hutch with LED lighting, cable management, and extensive storage for serious students.

reviews.author: Prateek Singh (Engineering Student)
reviews.title: Premium study workstation!
reviews.comment: LED lighting is perfect for late-night study sessions! Hutch design provides tons of storage. Cable management keeps everything tidy. Worth the investment!

reviews.author: Dr. Nair
reviews.title: Best desk for serious students!
reviews.comment: Daughter preparing for medical entrance loves it! Complete organization system is excellent. Extensive storage handles all her materials. Premium quality!
